caption:
Early in your career, what you learn compounds faster than salary does.

A role that stretches you raises what you're worth on every job change after it. A role that only pays more can leave you with three years of the same experience, repeated.

Not always true. If your family needs the money now, that matters more than any rule. But ask the question before you sign.
